title: Unit 8 Reading
description:
Email exchange: a faulty product

From: Edgars Liepa
To: customerservice@technoworld.lv
Subject: Faulty headphones – order 48215

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a pair of wireless headphones that I bought from your website on 3 March (order number 48215). When they arrived, I noticed that the left headphone didn't work. I contacted your helpline and was told that someone would call me back, but nobody did.

The headphones cost 89 euros, which is too much for a product that doesn't work. I would be grateful if you could send me a replacement or give me a full refund. I have attached a copy of my receipt. If I don't hear from you within seven days, I will contact the consumer protection office.

I look forward to your reply.

Yours faithfully,
Edgars Liepa

From: Inese Zarina
Subject: RE: Faulty headphones – order 48215

Dear Mr Liepa,

Thank you for your email, and I am very sorry for the trouble. I have checked your order and I can see that the headphones were sent on 4 March. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can either get a refund or choose a new pair of headphones. We will also send you a 10% discount code for your next order.

Please post the faulty headphones to the address below. We will pay for the delivery. When we receive them, the refund will be made within five working days.

Kind regards,
Inese Zarina, Customer Service Manager
